This document outlines the maintenance procedure P1, which must be performed for 
the Light fuel oil filter every one year as indicated by Y1 in the title block or when 
filter differential pressure is greater than 25 PSI .

 Mahmoud Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial inspection & quality control's

Turbines | Technical 
 Procedure
Introduction
Light fuel oil Filter
cleans the light oil from impurities and dirty.
This document outlines the maintenance procedure P1, which must be performed for 
the Light fuel oil filter every one year as indicated by Y1 in the title block or when 
filter differential pressure is greater than 25 PSI .
The first draft initiated 
by eng. Abdel El Hameed Abu Zeid, tested by eng. Ayman El Mor at 20 Jan 2005, 
revised by EDEPC inspection quality control eng. Abouda Elbana, and approved by 
eng. Mohamed Gouda Port Said Plant Director
This document accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; EDEPC MPIS 
 Coordinator, and certified by accountant 
 Mahmoud Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial inspection & quality control's 
 general director and supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, 
the qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable safety category,
Wear your safety helmet, 
 safety shoes, eye glass, nose mouth "dust cover" .... etc
Ensure that the inlet and outlet valves are closed
Drain the filter
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Rags, Cleaning Fluide
Work to be Carried Out
Changing Filter Cartridge
Close inlet and outlet valves
Open Drain and vent valves to Drain filter completely Before 
 removing Cartridges
Untight the filter cover bolts
Remove cover and old filter Cartridge
Clean thoroughly the filter internal surface
Insert new filter Cartridge
Clean cover gasket and gasket seat
Replace new gasket if it is hard or damage
Reassembly and Pushing Filter in Service
Place the filter cover and tight the cover bolts to 150 feet. 
 lb torque
Open inlet and outlet valve
Open vent to release air and close it when solar appears
Observe the Differential Pressure Gauge reading Less Than 25 
 Psi
